title: Muse Code from Claude Code: one real session, three substitutions
description: One recorded session of the plugin against Meta’s Muse Code 1.3.0. Each scene is the unedited stdout and stderr of one bridge command, paired with the slash command a user types. The repository path and home directory are substituted when the demo is built, and the login email was redacted in the capture files themselves.
footer: recorded 2026-09-18 against Muse Code 1.3.0; outputs unedited except repo path, home directory, and a redacted email

scenes.command: /muse:delegate --worktree --effort low fix the add function in math.js so it returns a + b, do not commit
/muse:delegate --resume --effort low which file did you change? reply with only the filename
/muse:delegate --background --effort low add a test file for math.js that checks add and div, then run it with node
